schemes.developerKey.description: "If you want to build a tool just for yourself, be it a desktop widget to display your balances or a tool to import transactions from a bank without a bank feed, you can use our developer keys feature. You can issue yourself a key which will give you persistent API access to just your account. You should rotate your keys regularly."

schemes.oauth2.description: "If you want to a create an app for PocketSmith that other PocketSmith users can use, you'll be using OAuth 2. To register an app with PocketSmith, please email us on api@pocketsmith.com. Let us know a bit about yourself and what you plan on building. When approved, you will be provided with your client_id and client_secret to start using OAuth. Then, check out our guide for integrating OAuth to get started."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["accounts.read"]: "Access to list and view transaction accounts"
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["accounts.write"]: "Access to update and delete transaction accounts"
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["attachments.write"]: "Ability to create, update and delete attachments"
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["events.write"]: "Ability to create, update and delete events"
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["transactions.read"]: "Access to list and view accounts and transactions"
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["transactions.write"]: "Access to create, update and delete transactions"
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["user.write"]: "Access to change the user's details and preferences"
